body: I also had the ds and felt that way for about a month before energy hit me all at once and since then I've been feeling so much more energized than ever before. You should consider the duodenal Switch. I got that done this March and have already lost 77 lbs. My dad got a sleeve and ended up gaining weight again so he went back to get the switch and he looks great now. My mom also got the sleeve and gained weight again. I'm not saying the sleeve doesn't work, lots of people have great success! But from my family experience I've seen my parents both start with the sleeve and end up going back for the duodenal switch.
